    """
    Return a new list where the elements at even indices of the input list `l`
    are sorted in ascending order, while elements at odd indices remain unchanged.

    '''
    Given the lengths of the three sides of a triangle. Return True if the three
    sides form a right-angled triangle, False otherwise.

    90 degree.

    # This also handles cases with non-positive side lengths.
    if not (a + b > c and a + c > b and b + c > a):
        return False

    # We square all sides to avoid floating-point inaccuracies from sqrt()
    # and to simplify the logic of checking Pythagoras' theorem.
    a_sq = a * a

    # to see which side is the hypotenuse.

            a_sq + c_sq == b_sq or
